geopolitics_summary: EU climate ambition faces pressure: Spain's conservatives threaten to relax climate rules; EU hints pragmatism on electrification at COP31.

themes.headline: EU backs COP31 electrification target despite pragmatism signals
themes.why_it_matters: Electrification pledge drives long-term EU power demand growth and supports merchant power valuations. However, climate chief's hint of 'pragmatism' suggests slower pace—medium-term DA spreads could compress if deployment timelines slip.

themes.headline: Spain's conservatives pledge to relax climate rules if they win election
themes.why_it_matters: Spain is EU's largest renewables producer by share. Conservative victory could slow wind/solar deployment, tightening EU power supply and supporting power prices. Snap election later November—outcome has intra-month transmission to Q1 power curve.

themes.headline: EU court rejects Poland's bid to overturn seven major climate laws
themes.why_it_matters: Confirms EU ETS compliance and climate regulations intact in large EU member. Supports EUA price floor; reduces regulatory whipsaw risk for carbon hedging over 2027 calendar.

themes.headline: U.S. Southwest hydropower hits record lows amid drought in Colorado Basin
themes.why_it_matters: US summer drought reduces hydropower generation, slightly increasing US thermal burn and global LNG demand. Indirect: tighter US LNG export optionality could marginally support TTF via reduced NW Europe LNG supply through winter 2026–27.

themes.headline: NATO warns Europe risks jet fuel shortage in major war due to fossil fuel shift
themes.why_it_matters: Defense-grade energy security concern. Implies EU may need to maintain oil refining / distillate capacity longer than green timeline permits. Indirect risk to power via political pressure to slow coal/gas phase-out—affects long-term CCGT stranding and EUA soft floor.

watchlist: Spain snap election later November—potential climate policy reset; monitor gas/power curve impact.
COP31 electrification pledge enforcement detail—check if binding timelines or soft targets; affects CCGT retirement assumptions.
Finland mining project decision—critical minerals vs. green resolve; shape EU RES supply chain confidence and industrial power demand.
